notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; this simulated R0 package has no hardware backend and no hardware run is claimed. The card's entry symbol go2.go2_env:Go2RSLEnvCfg (go2/go2_env.py:139) is the config the launcher passes to gym.make('Isaac-Velocity-Rough-Unitree-Go2-v0', cfg=cfg) (go2/go2_ctrl.py:81); the fake backend is the package's own kinematic stand-in (fake.py) because Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.1.0, ROS 2 Humble and the RSL-RL checkpoint are absent where the gate runs. The sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. NOT COVERED: the upstream observation vectors and height-scan array at their real lengths; the fake uses 12 joint values (placeholder) and 8 height-scan values, while the upstream height scan is the grid at 0.1 resolution over a 1.6 x 1.0 size (go2/go2_env.py:52-58) and the joint count comes from the external UNITREE_GO2_CFG. The action-space bound in the reference (-1.0 to 1.0 per element) is fake test data, not a sourced device limit; driver.py declares no Limit. Warnings are the expected Gymnasium-family ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1, G8.NO_UNIT for the four bridge-derived inputs (ticks, seed twice, action.values), and G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close) because native is the card's config class and the Gymnasium interface comes from its base outside the clone. No G4 warning. Only cap.world.reset/step/seed are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
